description: Source code for the NinjaTargetWriter class, responsible for generating Ninja build files for different target types in a build system, including handling dependencies, substitutions, and writing build rules.

classes.name: NinjaTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Ninja build rules for a specific build target, handling different target types, dependencies, and substitutions.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFile
methods.description: Static method that generates the Ninja build file for a given target, returning the command to include the generated subninja if applicable.

methods.name: WriteEscapedSubstitution
methods.description: Writes a substitution variable in Ninja syntax to the output stream.

methods.name: WriteSharedVars
methods.description: Writes common substitution variables used across build rules.

methods.name: WriteCCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes C compiler-related substitution variables based on target configuration.

methods.name: WriteRustCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes Rust compiler-related substitution variables based on target configuration.

methods.name: WriteInputDepsStampOrPhonyAndGetDep
methods.description: Generates a stamp or phony target for input dependencies and returns the list of dependencies.

methods.name: WriteStampOrPhonyForTarget
methods.description: Writes the build rule for a stamp or phony target based on the target's dependency output.

methods.name: WriteValidations
methods.description: Writes validation dependencies for the target.
